qa_pair.question: Using the stored active flag as the definition, how many users are active? Show the supporting aggregate and a metric.
What percentage of all users are active? Verify the denominator before presenting a part-to-whole chart.
Among active users, how many belong to Europe? Publish a regional breakdown with a captured-data region filter.
Among active users in Europe, how many are in team A? Show the region-to-team hierarchy.
How many active users are on team B across both regions? Show the source rows beside the aggregate.
Compare the active user counts in Europe and the United States. What is the absolute difference?
Filter to inactive users in Europe through a bound boolean query parameter. How many users remain?
What fraction of active users belong to team A, across both regions? Use the active population as the denominator.
How many users are in Europe including both activity states? Explain why a captured active-only result cannot answer this without a new query.
Produce a region-to-team breakdown of all users. Which team and region has the largest population, and what is that count? Report the count and note any ties.
